- **Core cognition model**
  - Eight HRS Core cognitive indicators; single-factor, complex-survey model
  - Initial model fit evaluated with WLSMV
  - Fixed-parameter factor scores estimated with MLR, a probit link, and EAP scoring
  - [Provenance: `R/A7_050-mplus_model.R`; `mplus_output/A7/model_1a_fixed/model_1a_fixed.inp`]
- **Score normalization**
  - Age, sex, race/ethnicity, education, and interaction covariates
  - Blom transformation; demographically adjusted residual T score
  - [Provenance: `R/A7_055-norm_factor_score.R`]
- **Rule-based classification**
  - Cognitive impairment; function; self-reported concerns; JORM for non-completers
  - Normal, MCI, Dementia classifications
  - [Provenance: `R/A7_075-implement_algorithm.R`]
- **Relationship to HRS/HCAP Algorithm**
  - HCAP-derived learning target; Core-measure operationalization
  - [Provenance: `R/A7_100-comparison_of_diagnoses.R`]
